title: Discovery of a highly potent CECR2 bromodomain inhibitor with 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d] pyrimidine scaffold.
authors: Lu, Haibo; Lu, Tian; Zu, Shijia; Duan, Zhe; Guang, Yiman; Li, Qi; Ma, Jingyi; Chen, Dongying; Li, Bo; Lu, Wenchao; Jiang, Hualiang; Luo, Cheng; Ye, Deyong; Chen, Kaixian; Lin, Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文报道CECR2溴结构域小分子抑制剂发现，基于分子对接设计化合物，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅对接无AI/物理模拟深度，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: Cat eye syndrome chromosome region candidate 2 (CECR2) bromodomain is a module of CECR2-containing remodeling factor (CERF), which is a chromatin remodeling complex correlating with transcriptional control and adjustment of chromatin architecture. Potent chemical probes would be beneficial to gain insights into the biochemical and pharmacological functions of CECR2 BRD. Herein, we report the discovery of a series of CECR2 BRD inhibitors with 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d] pyrimidine scaffold based on molecular docking model of TP-248 and CECR2 BRD. The most potent inhibitor of this series, DC-CBi-22 with IC(50) of 8.0 +/- 1.4 nM against CECR2 BRD and selectivity over BPTF BRD up to 24.9-fold. The SARs were detailed according to molecular docking. DC-CBi-22 would serve as a useful chemical probe for the study of CECR2.
abstract_zh: 猫眼综合征染色体区域候选2（CECR2）溴结构域是含CECR2的重塑因子（CERF）的一个模块，该因子是一种染色质重塑复合物，与转录调控及染色质结构调节相关。强效化学探针将有助于深入了解CECR2 BRD的生化及药理学功能。在此，我们基于TP-248与CECR2 BRD的分子对接模型，报道了一系列具有7H-吡咯并[2,3-d]嘧啶骨架的CECR2 BRD抑制剂。该系列中最有效的抑制剂DC-CBi-22，对CECR2 BRD的IC(50)为8.0 +/- 1.4 nM，且对BPTF BRD的选择性高达24.9倍。根据分子对接详细阐述了构效关系（SARs）。DC-CBi-22可作为研究CECR2的有用化学探针。
